saw_lines: Shoppers hunting retro games know the exact title they want, so they compare price and condition before they trust a seller.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides if this seller is worth a click.
Your 11 fixed copy ads open on 5 different stories, and one retro opener leads 6 of them. Test three new angles: consoles, childhood games, family game night.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your 11 fixed copy ads open on 5 different stories, and one retro opener leads 6 of them, so anyone who scrolled past it once sees the same pitch again. Test three new angles: consoles, childhood games, family game night.

One exact copy runs in 6 of your 11 fixed copy ads, so the same words reach the same buyers. Keep the copy but change the opening line and creative, so every ad feels new to someone who already saw it.
None of your 16 live ads shows a proof number, so a first-time buyer has no count to trust. Pick one real figure, such as orders shipped or reviews collected, and open your next ads with it.
13 of your 16 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a buyer who clicked a console has to search again. Point each ad to its matching product page, starting with the consoles.

ads_1: New openers on consoles, childhood games and family nights, tested against the retro opener.
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
